titulo_original: Opening Night: Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial VS That's the Weight of the World)

sinopsis.es: Questlove recorre los orígenes de Earth, Wind & Fire hasta su legado de actuaciones en vivo. Amigos y familia revelan cómo Maurice White construyó la banda y su amor por lo teatral.
sinopsis.en: Questlove traces Earth, Wind & Fire from their origins to a legacy of electrifying live performance. Friends and family reveal how founder Maurice White built the band — and its appetite for the theatrical.
